## Storage Intake
Validate both v2 routes and extract their persistence contracts.

## Storage Planning
Normalize the request and build/validate one ordered Drive queue.

## Google Drive Execution
Branch root handling, then process folder and text-file items with official Drive nodes.

## Verification
Collect every operation result and verify required work.

## Final Output
Return one stable Storage Result contract.
